options.name: action
options.description: Controls what snap-related action is performed. C(snap) collects system information and logs using snap command. C(snapcore) gathers core dumps and crash data using snapcore comamnd. C(snapsplit) splits and processes collected snap data using snapsplt command.

options.name: all_info
options.description: Gathers all available system information. This is a comprehensive option that includes data across all categories, such as hardware, software, configuration files, and logs.

options.name: collects_dump
options.description: Collects dump and /unix files, along with any live dump data. This is valuable for diagnosing kernel and system crashes

options.name: compress
options.description: Compresses the collected data into a single archive, typically snap.pax.gz. This is useful for easier file management and transport of the snapshot

options.name: file_system_info
options.description: Gathers file system information, including details on disk usage, mount points, and file system integrity. This is crucial for diagnosing storage and disk-related issues

options.name: general_info
options.description: Gathers general information.

options.name: hacmp
options.description: Gathers HACMP (High Availability Cluster Multiprocessing) error information. This is specific to AIX high-availability cluster environments and helps troubleshoot HA-related errors

options.name: hardware_info
options.description: Gather hardware information

options.name: installation_info
options.description: Gathers installation information, such as installed software packages, patches, and configurations. This helps diagnose installation-related issues.

options.name: kernel_info
options.description: Collects kernel-related data, including kernel configuration and status. This is essential for debugging kernel-specific issues.

options.name: live_kernel
options.description: Collects Live kernel update information and saves it in the /tmp/ibmsupt/liveupdate directory.

options.name: reset
options.description: Removes the snap output directory (default /tmp/ibmsupt). This cleans up previously gathered snapshot data, often to make room for a new snapshot

options.name: sc_core_file
options.description: Specifies the core file to be gather. Used for diagnosing system debugging.

options.name: sc_output_dir
options.description: Specifies the directory where snapcore output files will be stored. Helps in organizing collected core files.

options.name: sc_program_name
options.description: Defines the name of the program related to the core file.

options.name: sc_remove_core
options.description: Determines whether the core file should be removed after processing. If set to C(true), the core file will be deleted after analysis.

options.name: security_info
options.description: Gathers security information, including access controls, permissions, and user data. This is important for diagnosing security issues and auditing.

options.name: ss_filename
options.description: Specifies the filename for the snapsplit operation. This determines the output file name used for storing snap data.

options.name: ss_machinename
options.description: Specifies the machine name for the snapsplit operation. Helps in identifying the source system for the collected data.

options.name: ss_rejoining
options.description: Determines whether previously split snap files should be rejoined. If set to C(true), snapsplit will attempt to reconstruct snap files.

options.name: ss_size
options.description: Defines the size limit for snap data storage. Helps in controlling the disk space used by the snapsplit operation.

options.name: ss_timestamp
options.description: Specifies the timestamp for the snapsplit operation. This is useful for organizing and restoring snapshots based on time.

options.name: workload_manager_info
options.description: Gather workload manager (WLM) information, which includes data related to workload management on the system.
